payload.title: Ship a review control widget contract with thumbs mode, reason codes and a submit event
payload.description:
Generalize trace-ui/src/components/labeling-review.tsx into an embeddable review control (export path cyclotron/components/review-control). Props: itemId, decision {decisionId, label, confidence, classes, version}, reviewReason?, mode 'thumbs'|'labels', positiveLabel, reasons? [{code, label, labelEffect 'exclude'|'none'}], value?, disabled, compact. Events: onReview({itemId, decisionId, label, reasonCode, explanation}), onUndo({itemId, decisionId}). It never calls a server. Ordering: after the status shape (shares types).

Acceptance criteria:
- Thumbs up maps to positiveLabel; thumbs down requires a reason when reasons are given; a reason with labelEffect 'none' submits no label.
- The decision and confidence are visible before the reviewer chooses, and the control says it was shown before the review.
- Keyboard and screen-reader use pass the existing Vitest accessibility checks; UI strings use review, label, explanation, decision, confidence.
- The console's MultiLabelCard uses the new control, so there is one implementation.
